# Module: app

Juego de mesa en línea que permite a los jugadores crear y unirse a partidas.

## File Structure

| File | Purpose |
|------|------|
| `_layout.tsx` | TypeScript module that renders the game layout and its children |
| `index.tsx` | Entry point of the app that renders the game board and handles user input |

## Functions

| Name | Kind | Async | File | Description |
|------|------|------|------|------|
| RootLayout | function |  | `_layout.tsx` | Renders the game layout with its children. |
| PantallaJuego | function |  | `index.tsx` | Renders the game board and handles user input. |
| confirmarReiniciar | arrow |  | `index.tsx` | Confirms whether to restart the game or not. |
| manejarSiguiente | arrow |  | `index.tsx` | Handles the next step in the game flow. |

| Name | Kind | File |
|------|------|------|
| default | default | `_layout.tsx` |
| default | default | `index.tsx` |
